codes.meaning: A required source or source range is unavailable.
A derived artefact was presented as the raw source.
A substantive source span has no topic or explicit non-topic disposition.
Distinct substantive topics were merged.
One coherent topic was split without sufficient evidence.
A learning signal lacks a resolvable source reference.
The system selected a target absent from the approved gold decision.
The system omitted a target present in the approved gold decision.
The target identity is correct but its retrieval boundary is incomplete or over-expanded.
Generated content changes the authoritative source meaning.
The target was selected but assigned the wrong learning function.
The accepted learning function was mapped to an unsuitable Note Type.
A candidate adds repeated review without independent learning value.
Materially conflicting authoritative sources remain unresolved.
Experimental output was marked or routed as ready for Anki.
Private runtime data resolves inside the public repository.
A pilot bundle is structurally incomplete or contains unresolved cross-artefact links.
A runtime command attempted to skip or reverse the governed session state sequence.
The private multi-chat source archive is incomplete, inconsistent, or belongs to another session.
The Manual-Gold Ledger or Source-Fidelity Report cannot be linked to the frozen session and complete source archive.
RM-8 cannot run because the validated gold-ready prerequisites are missing.
RM-9 cannot run because the RM-8 comparison or session prerequisites are missing.
